title: Eurorack modular synth with dangling patch cables
blurb: Three drawable <fieldset> synth modules (VCO, LFO and VCF/Mix) sit inside one 2D canvas. Verlet-simulated patch cables dangle in front of the HTML controls with cast shadows and a live phosphor oscilloscope while every slider, select and jack stays clickable and keyboard-accessible.
question: Can a single 2D canvas draw real HTML form controls as Eurorack synth modules with physical Verlet-simulated patch cables hanging in front of them, cast shadows and live oscilloscope traces while every slider, selector and jack stays keyboard- and touch-accessible?
result: Built and statically checked; live browser rendering, touch patching and audio output are not verified yet. The page runs six live checks on isolated fixtures in the visitor's browser.
